summary: Feed sacrifice outlets with fodder (tokens and ETB creatures). [[Meren of Clan Nel Toth]] turns every death of another creature you control into an experience counter and, at the end step, either returns a graveyard creature at or under that experience total or puts it into hand. Drain payoffs (Zulaport, Cauldron, Konrad) convert the death count straight into damage, with a two-card [[Basking Broodscale]] loop as the unbounded closer when it is assembled.

phases.goal: Hit 2-3 lands plus a dork, land an outlet before Meren.
Cast Meren with an outlet and fodder already down; start banking experience and drains.
Assemble the Broodscale loop or chain edicts/Gray Merchant rebuys until the table is dead.

engine.title: Broodscale + Long Feng loop
flow: [[Basking Broodscale]] makes a Spawn
sac the Spawn to itself
[[Long Feng, Grand Secretariat]] counter on Broodscale
counter triggers another Spawn
repeat
engine.note: The Spawn is its own free outlet. A token reaches the graveyard before it ceases to exist (CR 111.7), so Long Feng's "another creature you control or a land you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield" fires every pass. Each loop is one death (feeds Zulaport/Cauldron/Konrad) and one experience counter for Meren.

engine.title: Broodscale + Mazirek loop
flow: [[Basking Broodscale]] makes a Spawn
sacrifice the Spawn
[[Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest]] counter on every creature
repeat for unbounded +1/+1s
[[Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord]] sacs a huge creature for damage
engine.note: Mazirek: "Whenever a player sacrifices another permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control." A Spawn sacrifice counts. With the team pumped, Jarad's "Sacrifice another creature: Each opponent loses life equal to the sacrificed creature's power" kills outright.

engine.title: Threshold sacrifice at Meren's end step
flow: [[Meren of Clan Nel Toth]] end-step trigger targets a graveyard creature card
sacrifice fodder in response for experience
trigger resolves, comparing that card's mana value with the new total
at or under: battlefield; over: hand
engine.note: Ruling: the count is the number of experience counters as the ability resolves, so sacrifices made in response still raise the threshold for that trigger. The target is chosen when the trigger goes on the stack (CR 603.3d), so a creature sacrificed in response can't be it.

engine.title: Mikaeus mass undying
flow: [[Mikaeus, the Unhallowed]] grants undying to non-Humans
sacrifice a Chupacabra/Gray Merchant/Blood Artist to a free outlet
it returns with a +1/+1 counter, re-triggering any ETB
repeat once per eligible creature
engine.note: "Other non-Human creatures you control get +1/+1 and have undying." Each eligible creature only loops once, since the returned copy carries the counter and undying checks for "no +1/+1 counters on it".

winConditions.name: Aristocrat attrition
flow: loop or chain sacrifices all game
each death triggers Zulaport/Cauldron/Konrad
opponents lose 1 life per death (Konrad also pings per creature card leaving your graveyard)
40 deaths (4-player pod) closes the table
winConditions.damage: 1 life per death per payoff on board; a 10-pass Broodscale loop with two payoffs out is 20 damage to each opponent
winConditions.turn: T6-8 estimate (not simulated), once the loop or a payoff plus fodder is assembled

winConditions.name: Gray Merchant recursion
flow: cast or reanimate [[Gray Merchant of Asphodel]] for a devotion drain
sacrifice it for an experience counter
Meren rebuys it at the end step (mana value 5)
repeat each turn devotion supports a real drain
winConditions.damage: X life per cast, where X is devotion to black; two ETBs via [[Saw in Half]] double it in one turn

winConditions.name: Broodscale loop kill
flow: assemble Broodscale with Long Feng or Mazirek
loop Spawn creation and sacrifice
each pass drains 1 (Zulaport/Cauldron/Konrad) or pumps the team (Mazirek)
loop to 40+ total drain, or swing lethal off Mazirek counters
winConditions.damage: unbounded — stop at 40+ drains for a 4-player pod, or once Mazirek counters clear everyone's life total in combat
winConditions.turn: as early as T3-4 (pilot guide §3 ideal line loops on T4; T3 off the Sol Ring keep below); later turns not simulated

swaps.reason: Sylvan Library left Meren for Tam, where the operator named this exact move to pair it with Tam's walker-loyalty payoffs. Meren still runs 11 other draw sources (Deadly Dispute, Village Rites, Grim Haruspex, Midnight Reaper, Morbid Opportunist, Moldervine Reclamation, Liliana, Dreadhorde General, ...), so the loss is small and no replacement was added.
swaps.quoteOut: At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw two additional cards. If you do, choose two cards in your hand drawn this turn. For each of those cards, pay 4 life or put the card on top of your library.
swaps.evidence: REFUTE.md row 5 (Tam side) and §6 donor-integrity note: "Library is 1 of Meren's 12 draw sources ... so the loss is small"

keepers.why: An operator lock (09-28 audit, final-swaps.json: 'The Gitrog, Ravenous Ride stays'). A 6/5 trample, haste body; after it deals combat damage, sacrificing the creature that saddled it draws X cards and puts up to X lands onto the battlefield, X = that creature's power.
The only other Broodscale-loop partner besides Mazirek, and it also counts land deaths (Fabled Passage, Myriad Landscape) as loop fuel. Nothing else in the identity replaces it.

Regenerates your whole board against destroy-based wipes, including your own Culling Ritual. It does nothing against -X/-X (Toxic Deluge, Massacre Wurm): a creature with toughness 0 is put into the graveyard and regeneration can't replace that (CR 704.5f). Its other modes kill X/1 tokens or an enchantment.

Slow (needs energy and a sacrifice each activation) but it is repeatable reanimation that also feeds Meren's experience count on the sacrifice. It is one of four non-Meren reanimation effects (with Reanimate, Victimize and Cauldron of Essence), and the only one that returns to hand to be reused.

A symmetric sacrifice tax looks risky, but every upkeep an opponent pays with a real permanent while the operator pays with tokens (Ophiomancer's Snake, Jadar's decayed Zombie). Stays for the fodder-asymmetry it creates.

With Golgari Charm it is one-sided against creatures: it destroys every nonland permanent with MV 2 or less and adds mana for each, while regeneration saves the operator's own small creatures (not Sol Ring or other MV 2 or less noncreatures).

pilotRules: Get an outlet (Viscera Seer, Carrion Feeder, Woe Strider) down before Meren, so a removal spell on Meren still banks experience.
At the end step: count experience first, then sacrifice in response to the trigger if you are one mana value short of the best target.
Never equip Lightning Greaves to Broodscale or Long Feng's target — shroud blocks your own targeting.

With Liliana, Dreadhorde General or Moldervine Reclamation out, every Spawn death is a mandatory draw: 40 deaths with one drain payoff is 40 draws (80 with both). Broodscale's Spawn is a 'may', so stop the loop before the library runs out.
Meren's target is locked in when the trigger goes on the stack, before any other end-step trigger (Braids, Arisen Nightmare) resolves — it cannot return a creature Braids just sacrificed.
Mikaeus grants no undying to Humans (Meren, Plaguecrafter, Ophiomancer, Syr Konrad, Long Feng, Braids, Cabal Minion are all Human), and undying never returns a creature that had a +1/+1 counter.
